notes.title: Just a little dose of landmines because they got freshly implemented!
notes.notes:
[p]Our work in the game continues at a good pace and we just implemented another set of weapons and one of our favourites are the landmines. They are specially lovely to deal with big groups of mutants on narrowy streets and are a lot of fun.

You can see them in action here:  [/p][previewyoutube="Q_gpz6pcab0;full"][/previewyoutube][p] We'll keep showing you guys some new fun weapons we are working on very soon! [/p]

notes.title: New Teaser Trailer released!
notes.notes:
[p]We just released the first teaser trailer of Terrible Life Expectancy, a horror roguelite where you inherit your upgrades only as long as there are members of your family still alive.
So this is basically a roguelite with limited lives as each family only has a specific number of relatives. When your family is exterminated, you'll have to choose another one and start your stats -kinda- from scratch.[/p][p]We liked the tension it might create with players knowing that every death counts because your upgrades up until that point stay only within your family.

We'll releasing more gameplay showing new features still under wraps in future trailers up until release.[/p][p][/p]
